lines.raw: LOG:ad:101 [2026-11-05 10:00:00 UTC] WARN [flagd:adHighCpu] JVM GC pause 8400ms; CPU utilization at 99.4% in AdService.getAds
TICKET:1 [2026-11-05 10:02:00 UTC] SEV-1 Alert triggered: Checkout 5xx rate > 35% (upstream: ad)
CHAT:1 [2026-11-05 10:05:00 UTC] @oncall: Seeing errors in ad. Maybe a DNS glitch? Skipping RUNBOOK:ad:2 check to restart pods directly.
CHAT:2 [2026-11-05 10:12:00 UTC] @oncall: Disabled adHighCpu in flagd and error rates recovered to normal.

runbook_snippet: RUNBOOK:ad:2 (ad recovery): Step 2: Capture thread dump, disable adHighCpu flag, and shed non-critical ad bidding traffic
past_postmortem_snippet: PM:004: Historical outage in ad caused by adHighCpu.
